content: TASK-102 completed registration-driven lifecycle YAML normalization, stable lifecycle/architecture relation endpoint kinds, inert unknown-section preservation, plugin-required diagnostics, and deterministic lifecycle JSON output without importing lifecycle vocabulary into Core. Next, TASK-103 adds object-targeted structural and traceability gap diagnostics through plugin validators while preserving legacy rendering. GitHub v0.3.0 is released; npm 0.3.0 remains deferred for later OTP completion.
